authority: OE14 estimates, OE16 material reference, OE17 coverage extension and OE18 approved sunflower revision; local research only
scope: Coverage-audited fixed-oil reference plus explicitly separated common-material additions. All identified omissions/variants in the finite local/catalog-evidence audit are accounted for; not a guarantee for all catalog or future market formulas.
matching: Trim and collapse whitespace, compare case-insensitively against only canonical_inci and listed aliases. Retain parentheses and plant-part/form words. A documented exact-product display normalization is a separate receipt, never a new generic alias.
interpretation: Rough material priors for equal modest leave-on comparisons near ordinary room temperature; no dose instruction, measured cutoff, efficacy, concentration, user eligibility or zero-residue implication. Use full-formula overlay before emitting product weight.
evidence_ceiling: No entry established a standardized validated hair-weight class. Supplier skin sensory, material behavior and limited generic hair-use descriptions inform authorized approximate priors; confidence means classification robustness.
